messages:
Maya (Growth): heads-up — launching a short multi-market momentum pulse starting tomorrow. focus: search + retargeting + fresh creative. goal: top-funnel CPL down 20% over 7 days.
Sam (Paid): timeline? budgets per market?
Maya (Growth): 72h staggered rollout across NA/EMEA/APAC. initial daily budget caps: NA $6k, EMEA $3k, APAC $2k. will add burst if CTR>1.2% after 24h.
Sam (Paid): got it. do we keep the current bidding strategy (tCPA) or switch to max conv w/ bid caps?
Ryan (Analytics): recommend max conv w/ +10% bid cap for NA, +8% for EMEA, +5% for APAC. historical conv lag for APAC is longer so we want slightly conservative caps.
Elena (Creative): I can push a refresh set: 3 headlines + 2 hero images per market, plus localized CTAs. want to A/B test a short-video variant in NA only.
Olivia (PM): landing page test? we should route traffic to the new feature landing (variant B) for NA and keep canonical for others. also add UTM params for downstream funnel.
Maya (Growth): yes — NA -> feature-landing-B, others -> feature-landing-A. Olivia can you confirm analytics flags?
Olivia (PM): confirmed. I'll add flags and the GA event. UTM format (copying for ad team):
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=momentum_pulse_2026&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_id}
```
Sam (Paid): can we include pinned negative keywords for retargeting lists?
Elena (Creative): tagging creatives with ids like creative_NA_vid1, creative_EMEA_img2 to match utm_content.
Ryan (Analytics): early metric targets for first 24h: CTR>1.0%, CPC< $2.20 (NA), conv rate >1.8% on landing-B. I'll post live dashboard link once dashboards are deployed.
Maya (Growth): cool. can AdsBot run the re-alloc script after 24h if NA is exceeding CTR threshold? @AdsBot run in 24h:check_and_burst --market=NA --threshold=1.2% --burst=+20%
AdsBot: scheduled job created: check_and_burst for market=NA at 1977086400. We'll post results in this thread. :robot_face:
Sam (Paid): one ask — for retargeting window, go 14d view, 7d click, and exclude users converted in last 30d.
Elena (Creative): creating ad copy variants now. quick mocks in Figma: https://redwood.figma.com/momentum-pulse (preview link)
Olivia (PM): also routing inbound leads: high-intent from form (score>=80) -> sales queue A, medium (50-79) -> nurture drip. Adding this to campaign docs.
Maya (Growth): reminder: keep frequency capping at 4/day for retargeting and 10/day for search (impression capping where possible).
Sam (Paid): will set caps in platform. posting snippet of campaign config:
```
campaigns = [
  {"market":"NA","budget":6000,"bidding":"max_conv","bid_cap":0.10},
  {"market":"EMEA","budget":3000,"bidding":"max_conv","bid_cap":0.08},
  {"market":"APAC","budget":2000,"bidding":"max_conv","bid_cap":0.05}
]
retargeting = {"view_window_days":14,"click_window_days":7,"exclude_converted_days":30}
```
Ryan (Analytics): quick note: tie impressions -> user_id hashed for privacy before sending to analytics.
Elena (Creative): uploaded assets to CDN and added tags. will drop final names here when ready.
Maya (Growth): perfect. primary checkpoints: t+24h quick triage, t+72h optimization pass, t+7d performance review. I'll run a short debrief doc after 7d.
Sam (Paid): t+24h I'll post raw spend + performance.
AdsBot: reminder: campaign(s) scheduled to go live at 1977080000. Pre-launch checklist status: creatives=ready, tracking=ready, budgets=ready.
Olivia (PM): all set from PM side. good luck team :rocket: 
Maya (Growth): thanks all — let's reconvene t+24h here.
